name: Late favourite, 15m BTC
source: A published third-party backtest, parameters read 2026-09-10. Reported 93% win rate, Sharpe 1.72.
notes: The published rules also carry stop losses (sell all at a 0.55 yes bid, or a 0.95 yes bid against a NO position). Those need the price path AFTER entry and are NOT scored here — the spec parser rejects an exit it cannot model rather than ignoring it, so this audits the hold-to-settlement version and says so. The entry signal is a proprietary black box we cannot reproduce, so this measures the strategy WITHOUT it: what the filters alone select. SETTLEMENT BASIS: implementations of this family are known to drive off a Coinbase feed while KXBTC15M settles on CF Benchmarks' BRTI, a multi-exchange index. Measured 2026-09-11 over 614 settled markets, Coinbase agrees with the settled direction 97.6% of the time overall but only 64% inside 0.5bp and 89% inside 1bp — and a market quoted at 0.65-0.95 with 90 seconds left is, by construction, one of the close ones. The proxy is reliable exactly where the market already agrees and unreliable exactly where an edge would live.
